items.exampleEn: Disorder broke out at the station when all the trains were canceled.
items.exampleZh: 所有列車都取消時，車站裡一片混亂。

items.exampleEn: The police put up a barrier to stop cars from entering the street.
items.exampleZh: 警方設了路障，不讓車子開進那條街。

items.exampleEn: She has a developing interest in photography.
items.exampleZh: 她對攝影的興趣正在逐漸發展。

items.exampleEn: After the expansion, the park has room for twice as many visitors.
items.exampleZh: 擴建之後，這座公園能容納的遊客多了一倍。

items.exampleEn: The farming revolution happened thousands of years ago.
items.exampleZh: 農業革命發生在幾千年前。

items.exampleEn: Animals evolve slowly over millions of years.
items.exampleZh: 動物在數百萬年間慢慢演化。

items.exampleEn: The fate of the old theater will be decided next month.
items.exampleZh: 那座老劇院的命運將在下個月決定。

items.exampleEn: Good storytellers use variation in their voice to keep listeners interested.
items.exampleZh: 會說故事的人會讓聲音有所變化，讓聽眾保持興趣。

items.exampleEn: Our old roof needs a radical solution, not more small repairs.
items.exampleZh: 我們的舊屋頂需要徹底的解決辦法，而不是再做小修補。

items.sentenceEn: The town slowly evolved from a quiet village into a busy port.
items.sentenceZh: 這個小鎮從安靜的村莊，慢慢發展成熱鬧的港口。

items.audioEn: Language was the biggest barrier when I first moved to Japan, but now I speak it well.
items.audioZh: 我剛搬到日本時，語言是最大的障礙，但現在我說得很好了。
items.questionZh: 說話者剛搬到日本時，最大的困難是什麼？

items.sentenceEn: My desk is always in disorder at the end of a busy week.
items.sentenceZh: 忙碌的一週結束時，我的桌子總是亂七八糟。

items.sentenceEn: The internet started a revolution in the way we share news.
items.sentenceZh: 網路為我們分享新聞的方式帶來了一場革命。

items.stemEn: Prices show little ____ from one shop to another; they are almost the same everywhere.
items.stemZh: 各家店的價格幾乎沒有變化，到哪裡都差不多。

items.stemEn: Many ____ countries are building new roads and schools.
items.stemZh: 許多發展中國家正在興建新的道路和學校。

items.passageEn: When Ben took over his father's bakery, the kitchen was in disorder and the business was losing money. He decided to change its fate. First, he studied the market and found that the main barrier to growth was the shop's dull image. So he started a small revolution: he added coffee, free internet, and seasonal variations of the classic breads. The bakery slowly evolved into a popular meeting place, and sales rose considerably. Two years later, Ben planned an expansion: a second shop in a developing part of the city. Many customers say these radical changes saved the shop.
items.passageZh: Ben 接手父親的麵包店時，廚房一團亂，生意也在虧錢。他決定改變麵包店的命運。首先，他研究市場，發現成長的主要障礙是店面形象太沉悶。於是他發起一場小小的革命：增加咖啡、免費網路，還推出經典麵包的季節變化款。麵包店慢慢變成熱門的聚會場所，業績也大幅成長。兩年後，Ben 計畫擴張，在城裡一個發展中的地區開第二家店。很多顧客說，這些徹底的改變救了這家店。

questions.questionZh: Ben 發現麵包店成長的主要障礙是什麼？
options: 店面給人的形象太沉悶

questions.questionZh: 兩年後 Ben 計畫做什麼？

items.promptZh: 這家公司的擴張速度很快。
referenceEn: The company's expansion has been very fast.
The company is going through a rapid expansion.
rubricZh: expansion 是名詞（例如 the company's expansion、a rapid expansion）
沒有時間標記，現在式、現在完成式、過去式都可以

items.promptZh: 命運讓這兩個老朋友在同一座城市重逢。
referenceEn: Fate brought the two old friends together again in the same city.
Fate brought the two old friends back together in the same city.
rubricZh: fate 指「命運」，可當主詞（例如 Fate brought… 等）
「重逢」可寫，例如 brought … together again、brought … back together、let them meet again 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式
